# On and off by default — the `testing` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#testing).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** `package.json` depends on `jest`, `vitest`, `@testing-library/*` or `@playwright/test`.
- **Rules:** 174 — 0 on, 77 on with `preview = true`, 0 off in an opt-in preset, 97 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `testing/jest` | when `package.json` depends on `jest` | 17 | 15 error, 2 warn | eslint-plugin-jest 29.17.0's `recommended`, reimplemented (W-139) |
| `testing/vitest` | when `package.json` depends on `vitest` | 15 | 13 error, 2 warn | @vitest/eslint-plugin 1.6.28's `recommended`, reimplemented (W-139) |
| `testing/testing-library` | when `package.json` depends on `@testing-library/*` | 22 | 13 error, 9 warn | eslint-plugin-testing-library 7.16.2's `react` config, reimplemented (W-139) |
| `testing/playwright` | when `package.json` depends on `@playwright/test` | 34 | 12 error, 22 warn | eslint-plugin-playwright 2.12.1's `recommended`, reimplemented (W-139) |
